name: Limn
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single line of light: the coastline of a Julia set, located by a derivative-tracked distance estimate and drawn as one unbroken, infinitely wrinkled luminous contour on near-black. A hidden seed orbits, so the whole line continuously re-poses — tendrils extend, bays close, islands pinch off and rejoin — while the palette pours slowly around the figure.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Core stroke width of the coastline in CSS pixels, from etched hairline to soft pen.

params.label: Halo reach
params.effect: Width in CSS pixels of the faint glow skirt around the core line, from bare ink to a misty corona.

params.label: Writhe speed
params.effect: Orbit speed of the hidden seed, i.e. how quickly the drawn line re-poses itself.

params.label: Zoom
params.effect: Magnification about frame centre — higher values trade the whole figure for one long wandering stretch of line.
